div.h2: Password created + 2FA not verified = inactive account • Password created + 2FA verified = active account
If the 5-minute setup challenge expires or five attempts are reached, the incomplete inactive account is deleted.
If the original invitation is still within its 7-day lifetime, the worker can reopen it and restart the setup.
Invitation lifetime: 7 days • TOTP setup challenge: 5 minutes • Maximum TOTP attempts: 5
